Chapter 6673: Try And See

Chapter 6673: Try And See

The conversation between the trio left listeners confused.

“Dying might prove to be the greatest challenge, Fellow Daoist.” Evil Transformation said.

“We all say that our fate is our own. I’m afraid this isn’t the case for us, not even you.” Fiendish Ground added.

“Speak for yourselves.” Li Qiye smirked.

“Is that true, Fellow Daoist?” The two became serious.

“Of course, I decide, whether it be here or outside.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Fellow Daoist, your body is still around, how do you compare with him?” Evil Transformation asked.

“Nothing changes since it isn’t difficult for me to let go.” Li Qiye said.

“What if you change your mind?” Fiendish Ground asked.

“It came from this world so it should return to this world, I will do so when the time comes, it is but a single thought.” Li Qiye said.

“Do you believe you can intimidate us?” Fiendish Ground asked.

“Feel free to try since you’re already here.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Of course, our business has to be settled eventually.” Evil Transformation said without any hesitation.

“Times are different, I can slay the two of you fully now.” Li Qiye said.

This startled the two. Bao Pu heard this and murmured to himself: “How can this be?”

The primordial immortals were still stronger than Zhan Sansheng and Desolate Ancestor. Could Li Qiye kill the two at the same time?

Of course, he wouldn’t make this claim without ample confidence.

“Fellow Daoist, that strand of primordial light still couldn’t kill us completely.” Fiendish Ground said.

“That’s in the past. How do you two want to die?” Li Qiye asked.

“This intrigues me.” Evil Transformation said.

“Don’t worry, killing twenty or thirty of you wouldn't be a problem for me.” Li Qiye smiled.

This was inconceivable for the crowd. If there were twenty of them, this world would be crushed immediately just by their presence.

“Are there that many primordial immortals?” A primal ancestor wondered.

The two knew Li Qiye had killed all the primordial immortals in the outer world. Of course, he used that special primordial light for the explosion.

Now, the returned Li Qiye didn’t have it any longer and could only rely on his strength. They didn’t have a clear assessment of his power.

“You are certainly strong, Fellow Daoist, but not enough to make us retreat.” Fiendish Ground said.

“Retreat? Your roots are here, there’s nowhere else to go.” Li Qiye said.

“We wish to try this path, are you interested?” Evil Transformation asked.

“I don’t know if you are confident in yourself or confident in him. Actually, perhaps underestimating him.” Li Qiye said.

The two weren’t sure but since it had gotten this far, they must continue down this path.

“We have entered the astral form, there’s no going back.” Fiendish Ground said.

“Can’t wait any longer.” Li Qiye smiled.

“This is it, if we don’t do anything, you’ll take it.” Evil Transformation said.

“Yes, that is correct, I wouldn’t leave it here, and absolutely not for you two to take.” Li Qiye said.

“Then if you don’t mind, we’ll be taking it now to use.” Evil Transformation said.

“Unnecessary question since I want to see it, which is why you two are still standing before me. The outcome will still be the same, it will only take slightly longer to kill you two.” Li Qiye said.

“We also want to see if you have reached this level.” Fiendish Ground said.

“I’m afraid you won’t be able to see it.” Li Qiye shook his head: “You may put on this shell but still won’t reach his height.”

The two immortals remained silent. After a short while, Evil Transformation said: “Yes, still not him, but how many in history have reached this height?”

“True.” Li Qiye stroked his chin: “Given your current ability in addition to the shell, it would be rather difficult to find an equal in Heavenrealm.”
